name: Toast
rungReason: Announcing, timing, pausing and queueing need script; the element uses ariaNotify() or a live region, and a manual popover for the top layer.

a11y.role: region (the list), status (the fallback live region)
a11y.name: Notifications
a11y.description: Each message is announced once, politely, when shown (WCAG 4.1.3)

keyboard.action: Reaches a toast's buttons in the page's order (the region is at the end of the page)
Dismiss the focused toast; focus goes back where it came from

focus.return: Where focus came from, when a focused toast leaves
focus.indicator: An inverse outline on the toast's buttons

elementRules: Render it empty; it creates and owns everything inside and writes nothing outside itself.

enhancements.fallback: An always-rendered role=status region whose text is replaced

knownGaps.where: While a modal dialog is open
knownGaps.gap: The region shows above it but is inert, so a toast's buttons can't be used
knownGaps.policy: Show toasts after the dialog closes, or put the message in the dialog

rules: Leaves after 6 s by default, paused while hovered or focused; a toast with an action stays until used or dismissed (WCAG 2.2.1)
At most three at once; the rest queue
Status only: errors that need action belong in the page (Alert, error summary)
withoutJavaScript: Nothing shows: put server messages in the page as an Alert
motion: Rises and fades in; instant under reduced motion
contrast: The inverse surface already passes the -more contrast levels
